estimands.1_ABSOLUTE_EXTERNAL_PERFORMANCE: frozen system performance (Dice / IoU / precision / recall / accuracy) on each eligible external cohort
estimands.2_INTERNAL_TO_EXTERNAL_SHIFT: external performance minus the appropriate frozen internal reference (reference must be named prospectively per cohort)
estimands.3_CROSS_DOMAIN_BALANCED_SUMMARY: only if prospectively defined with explicit pre-declared weights
